description: Flow 2, user install: Go's recorded user unit (deploy/opute-host-agent.service) for the existing user ubuntu with its env file, --check, enable and serve on a configured port; then the npm launcher packed locally from the pinned tree (never published), started as the docs show against a local release base, with url, status and stop. The user unit is stopped first: both are the user's default instance, and under D25 they would refuse each other.

inputs.agent: Rust 0.3.0 release candidate binary as ubuntu (user unit) and as the launcher's cached binary

requirements.scenario: user unit: Go's recorded deploy/opute-host-agent.service; standalone loopback bind, configured port

requirements.requirement: Published npm launcher: start --background, url, status, stop
requirements.scenario: @opute/host-agent@0.3.0 packed locally from the pinned launcher tree with only its version changed (never published), with a local release base; the launcher runs the pinned release binary

steps.guest: loginctl enable-linger ubuntu && for i in $(seq 60); do test -S /run/user/$(id -u ubuntu)/systemd/private && break; sleep 0.5; done

U=ubuntu; H=/home/ubuntu; install -d -o $U -g $U $H/.local $H/.local/share $H/.local/share/opute $H/.config $H/.config/opute $H/.config/systemd $H/.config/systemd/user && gzip -dc /opt/opute-e2e/releases/rust/v0.3.0/host-agent-linux-x64.gz > /tmp/oha && install -o ubuntu -g ubuntu -m 0755 /tmp/oha /home/ubuntu/.local/share/opute/opute-host-agent && rm /tmp/oha && sha256sum /home/ubuntu/.local/share/opute/opute-host-agent | cut -c1-64 && install -o $U -g $U -m 0644 /opt/opute-e2e/deploy-user/opute-host-agent.service $H/.config/systemd/user/opute-host-agent.service && (umask 077 && printf 'OPUTE_REMOTE_AGENT_ID=e2e-user-agent
MCP_AUTH_TOKEN=%s
HOST_MCP_PORT=3015
' '${SECRET:user}' > $H/.config/opute/host-agent.env) && chown $U:$U $H/.config/opute/host-agent.env

R=/run/user/$(id -u ubuntu); runuser -u ubuntu -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=$R systemctl --user daemon-reload && R=/run/user/$(id -u ubuntu); runuser -u ubuntu -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=$R systemctl --user enable --now opute-host-agent.service && for i in $(seq 120); do curl -fsS -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:3015/health && break; sleep 0.5; done && python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py unit opute-host-agent.service --user ubuntu
R=/run/user/$(id -u ubuntu); runuser -u ubuntu -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=$R systemctl --user disable --now opute-host-agent.service

systemd-run --unit=e2e-release --collect python3 -m http.server 8765 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory /opt/opute-e2e/releases/rust && for i in $(seq 40); do curl -fsS -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8765/v0.3.0/SHA256SUMS && break; sleep 0.25; done

cd /home/ubuntu && runuser -u ubuntu -- env HOME=/home/ubuntu PATH=/opt/opute-e2e/node/bin:/usr/bin:/bin NPM_CONFIG_OFFLINE=true NPM_CONFIG_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=false OPUTE_HOST_AGENT_RELEASE_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8765 OPUTE_REMOTE_AGENT_ID=e2e-npm-agent MCP_AUTH_TOKEN=${SECRET:npm} HOST_MCP_PORT=3016 npm exec --yes --offline --package=/opt/opute-e2e/opute-host-agent-0.3.0.tgz -- opute-host-agent start --background

cd /home/ubuntu && runuser -u ubuntu -- env HOME=/home/ubuntu PATH=/opt/opute-e2e/node/bin:/usr/bin:/bin NPM_CONFIG_OFFLINE=true NPM_CONFIG_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=false OPUTE_HOST_AGENT_RELEASE_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8765 OPUTE_REMOTE_AGENT_ID=e2e-npm-agent MCP_AUTH_TOKEN=${SECRET:npm} HOST_MCP_PORT=3016 npm exec --yes --offline --package=/opt/opute-e2e/opute-host-agent-0.3.0.tgz -- opute-host-agent url

cd /home/ubuntu && runuser -u ubuntu -- env HOME=/home/ubuntu PATH=/opt/opute-e2e/node/bin:/usr/bin:/bin NPM_CONFIG_OFFLINE=true NPM_CONFIG_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=false OPUTE_HOST_AGENT_RELEASE_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8765 OPUTE_REMOTE_AGENT_ID=e2e-npm-agent MCP_AUTH_TOKEN=${SECRET:npm} HOST_MCP_PORT=3016 npm exec --yes --offline --package=/opt/opute-e2e/opute-host-agent-0.3.0.tgz -- opute-host-agent status
pid=$(ss -ltnpH 'sport = :3016' | grep -o 'pid=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); sha256sum /proc/$pid/exe | cut -c1-64

cd /home/ubuntu && runuser -u ubuntu -- env HOME=/home/ubuntu PATH=/opt/opute-e2e/node/bin:/usr/bin:/bin NPM_CONFIG_OFFLINE=true NPM_CONFIG_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=false OPUTE_HOST_AGENT_RELEASE_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8765 OPUTE_REMOTE_AGENT_ID=e2e-npm-agent MCP_AUTH_TOKEN=${SECRET:npm} HOST_MCP_PORT=3016 npm exec --yes --offline --package=/opt/opute-e2e/opute-host-agent-0.3.0.tgz -- opute-host-agent stop
loginctl disable-linger ubuntu && systemctl stop user@$(id -u ubuntu).service
